newsitem.title: CANADA: Stone holders okay Abitibi merger.
newsitem.headline: Stone holders okay Abitibi merger.

text.p: Stone-Consolidated Corp shareholders approved a merger with Abitibi-Price Inc, which would create the world's largest newsprint maker, at an annual meeting on Thursday.

Abitibi shareholders, who are concurrently holding a gathering in Toronto, have yet to vote on the merger, an Abitibi spokesman said. "The meeting is going on as we speak. So we won't hear for a while yet."
The merged firm, to be called Abitibi-Consolidated Inc, would be headquartered in Montreal and save C$100 million annually in reduced costs.

Chicago-based Stone Container Corp will see its 47-percent stake in Stone-Consolidated reduced to 25 percent in Abitibi-Consolidated after the two firms hold an all-stock swap in a deal valued at C$4.1 million.
